answer: Tie each agent identity to a bonded stake, the way a ship is moored at a wharf: to transact it must post collateral that established peers attest against its funding source. Spinning up a thousand sybils then demands a thousand distinct bonds, and any that share a hidden funding root snag like a hull on a reef and are slashed on detection. The ledger watches like a raven; every forged attestation burns the attackers capital faster than one honest identity earns, so the cheap-clone fleet sinks under its own posted cost.
